pages.title: Higgs Field Capacitor
pages.text: A device that holds a local excitation of the Higgs field, the field that gives fundamental particles their mass. Inside, the field sits slightly away from its usual value, so objects nearby feel faintly heavier or lighter. It is dense, cool, and handles mass the way an ordinary capacitor handles charge.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A magnetic monopole wrapped in a superconducting coil in the Topological Phase Transmuter created a tiny defect in the vacuum. The Higgs field pooled around it, and with a qubit and a condensate I learned to store that excitation.
